get_credits.description: Return the number of email-validation credits remaining on the connected ZeroBounce account. Useful for checking the balance before running a large validation job.
get_credits.display_str_template: Get the number of remaining ZeroBounce credits.
get_credits.name: get_credits

verify_email.description: Validate a single email address and return its deliverability status. The status is one of valid, invalid, catch-all, unknown, spamtrap, abuse, or do_not_mail, alongside a sub_status, mailbox and domain details, and any name, gender, or location ZeroBounce could append. Each call consumes one ZeroBounce credit.
verify_email.name: verify_email

parameters.description: The email address to validate, for example jane@example.com.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: Optional. The IPv4 or IPv6 address the email signed up from, used to append geolocation to the result. Leave empty if you don't have it.
parameters.name: ip_address

account.description: The local part of the address (before the @)

did_you_mean.description: A suggested correction for a likely typo

domain.description: The domain part of the address (after the @)

domain_age_days.description: Age of the domain in days

email.description: The email address that was validated

firstname.description: First name ZeroBounce associated with the address

free_email.description: Whether the domain is a free email provider

gender.description: Gender ZeroBounce associated with the address

lastname.description: Last name ZeroBounce associated with the address

mx_found.description: Whether an MX record was found ("true"/"false")

mx_record.description: The MX record the domain resolves to

raw_response.description: The full original ZeroBounce validation payload

smtp_provider.description: The SMTP provider serving the domain

status.description: Deliverability status: valid, invalid, catch-all, unknown, spamtrap, abuse, or do_not_mail

sub_status.description: More specific reason behind the status

description: Validate email addresses with ZeroBounce and check how many validation credits your account has left.
